en: A vintage multiview illustrated postcard showing several scenes of a riverside or lakeside town. The top left view depicts a large classical building and surrounding parkland; the bottom left shows quays, boats, and waterfront buildings; the right view shows steamships and sailing vessels on open water with a pier or harbor. In the center is a circular vignette of a smaller civic-looking building. Decorative flowers and ornate lettering spell out a greeting and the town name, "Wenersborg." The layout leaves a blank space on the right for writing.
